abstract: Kinsta is a premium managed WordPress host. EXPERTE measured 99.977% uptime over 6 weeks. The Black Friday offer is for new customers and ends 1 December.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: It can be for a business site that needs speed and support. EXPERTE measured 99.977% uptime over 6 weeks. The cost is the main con.
The Launch plan lists at $35 a month. Larger plans run to $299 a month, agency plans to $675, and enterprise from $500.

mainEntity.name: Does Kinsta have a Black Friday deal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes: 50% off for 3 months on monthly plans, or 3 months free on annual billing. It is for new customers and ends on 1 December 2026.
EXPERTE reports AI and live chat support, with no phone line.

mainEntity.name: Does Kinsta have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kinsta lists a 30-day money-back guarantee on its pricing page.
We found no built-in AI assistant on the pricing page. Kinsta has an API and an APM tool, and it publishes tutorials on building an MCP server.
